opening.argument: The offer ties recruitment directly to income: earnings are described as coming from recommendations and “building the structure of people,” alongside a bonus plan said to have enabled 400 people to earn 35,000 euros a week in twelve months. Viewers are urged to join as partners, with registration bringing a wealth code and instructional materials. The presentation also bolsters the offer with a claim that OneCoin rose from 0.1 Euro to 2.5 Euro. Together, recruitment-based earnings, unusually high reported income, and claimed currency growth make this a recruitment-commission and tiered-matrix scheme. The video directs viewers to submit their name and email, but it does not establish the accuracy of its claims, how that data is handled, or whether any transaction or benefit results.
